name: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber
archDisplay: The Gemini 3.8 Flash core specialised for defensive cybersecurity, served under a separate access envelope; same Flash-tier speed and cost profile
note: Released alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash on September 2, 2026 for trusted defenders through Google's new Fairwind Program — one core model, two access envelopes. Google reports frontier-level autonomous vulnerability discovery on CyberGym, surpassing both 3.5 Flash Cyber and significantly larger frontier models, plus an internal benchmark spanning 20+ languages built because CyberGym is C/C++-only; neither carries a published numeral, so neither is recorded. The one citable number is CWE-Bench patching. Wiz separately reports +7.5-9.7% higher recall on its internal penetration-testing benchmark at 2.3-5.2x lower cost than other leading frontier models. No public per-token rate — access is program-gated, not self-serve — so the entry ships with a single result row and stays below the ranking-coverage floor.
